text: Thanks a lot. Since they do not require any infrastructure, our our networks are easy to deploy, and also they do not cost much because in principle you may not need any deployment of infrastructure at all, as we said. So we know already that these kind of systems are also called ad hoc, because a network indeed can be set up, which is potently whenever needed, ad hoc for an environment, for a situation, or for supporting an application. For example, for civil applications, whenever we have an emergency a disaster area, this is the kind of networks that are going to be deployed. We made already examples regarding floating slides, earthquakes, and the case where squad emergency teams need to be on the area, and of course the members of the squad need to communicate with each other. So in that case, this is indeed that that is a good example of device to device communication networks, where indeed we do not have any infrastructure because the infrastructure has been disrupted by the flooding or the slide or or the earthquake, and so we have pure device to device communication. But as mentioned already.
